Mehbooba Mufti links RSS chief's remarks to journalist assault

Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti stated that RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's remarks about Muslims in the US were 'hollow' following an alleged assault on journalists in Delhi. The alleged assault occurred on journalists covering a protest by the Delhi Police against a farmers' union. Mufti linked the two events, suggesting a broader pattern. The RSS chief's assertion, which Mufti deemed hollow, was not detailed in the coverage.
